scripts.build: npm run build -w fe && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w fe && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests public scripts/api-check-context.ts scripts/check-*.ts package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests public scripts/api-check-context.ts scripts/check-*.ts package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:mock: prettier --write fe/src fe/tests shared server scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.format:mock:check: prettier --check fe/src fe/tests shared server scripts/dev.mjs
